summary: Two 30-ft towers built by 1932, one at Majette; a 1948 item gives 85 ft; sold at auction in 2008; no source describes the site today.

events.note: January 1932 newspaper item: two 30-foot observation towers constructed, one at Old Majette in Bay County and one at Smith's Still in Calhoun County.
September 1940 item: improvement of the lookout tower site at Majette was well advanced.
Labelled Majette Fire Tower on a USGS topographic map published 1945.
January 1948 item: tower three miles east of Bayou George, 85 feet high, of steel. Conflicts with the 1932 height and location.
Sold at auction, per the lookout page. Sources do not say what happened after.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1932 item gives 30-foot towers (9.1 m, kept in facts). The 1948 item gives 85 feet for a tower three miles east of Bayou George. The sources do not say whether these are the same tower, rebuilt, or moved, so the 1932 figure stays in facts and the conflict is stated in the story.
The 1932 item places the tower about five miles east of Bayou George and the 1948 item places it three miles east. Not resolved by the sources.

sources.title: Majette - FOREST LOOKOUTS (quoting the Pensacola News Journal and the Panama City News-Herald)
1945 Map of North Of Allanton, Panama City, FL (USGS topographic map, published 1945)

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today. Height and location conflict between the 1932 and 1948 items is unresolved. The newspaper items come only as quotes on the Eastern US Lookouts page; the originals were not checked. The 2008 auction note has no named source beyond that page. The anyplaceamerica.com listing (Majette Lookout Tower) returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Florida Forest Service and Bay County records were not searched.
